body.p: Where did the mosquitoes come from? I'll tell a story. Long time ago there lived people.[ShA:] There is no title in the audiorecording. They lived together. And one day two men went into the forest. The women stayed home. One man didn't come back, and one came back. His wife asked: "Where is my husband?" The man replied: "Your husband stayed there." He must have met a witch. There were a lot of witch girls running around in the forest. And one witch girl took his hand and led him away. The women cried, they feel sorry for their friend. And this man is still not here, not here. He is away for a long, long time. The night fell, he is still not here. Then he came and screamed loudly. "Open the door for me, I have brought a new wife." She is a good wife, she will work a lot, she will work well. The woman started to cry and went out of the house. He came in, and this witch is scary, huge, laughing. "Me, â she said, â I am the nicest person, I am the witch's child. If you beat me or do something to me, then, â she said, â you will always live badly." The next day, people gathered and lit a big, big fire. The witch says: "Oh, lunch, shall we cook the food?" The man said: âSister-in-law, go get some water.â. She jumped up, ran and brought a bucket of water. Then the men pushed her. So the witch fell. And she burned in the fire. Then she shouted: "From my ashes, mosquitoes will appear, flies will appear, all kinds of insects. Let them not give people to live, they eat them and torture them. Let them live so badly after they killed me." The witch died, immediately mosquitoes, flies fly, all sorts of insects fly. Before that. There were no such things before. After the witch's death, people began to live poorly.
